what: Remeasurement of the shipped grc-joint-v3 checkpoint on dbbe-lingann-fold-v2 (DBBE Byzantine book-epigram gold standard).
protocol: greek.use_neural_pipeline(); CPU sequential (canonical); gold tokenization; official CoNLL-2018 evaluator; greek.evaluate_on_dbbe() (tagging-only, parse=False); fold dbbe-lingann-fold-v2 (sha 14b5496d...), built from coswaele/ByzantineGreekDatasets @ 0b0133a9: 825 sentences / 9,191 tokens; leakage 0
why_remeasured: The DBBE row is superseded but NOT by these corrections. Measured with the corrections applied and again with them reverted to the base commit, the fold returns byte-identical values both times, so the two corrections are inert on this fold (it carries no apparatus marks and is scored tagging-only). The differences against training/results/dbbe-eval-v2-2026-07-11.json are one token each in UPOS (+1), XPOS (-1) and lemma (-1), with UFeats unchanged; they accumulated somewhere in the 0.45.0-0.57.2 window and were not detected because scripts/check_benchmarks.py re-measures only the offline-stack rows. The value recorded here is the current measurement.
vs_2026_07_11: UPOS 86.74->86.75, XPOS 76.40->76.39, lemma 76.71->76.69, UFeats 85.86 unchanged: one token in each of the three moved cells, over the same fold and the same model weights.
